character.appendages: Exactly two broad crown blades are attached to the body crown and deform as a paired flexible structure. No arms, hands, wings, horns, floating ornaments, tail or additional leaf is permitted.
character.contactAndOrigin: Shared source origin is [22,38] on a 64x64 canvas. Upright cells keep root contacts near that origin; lifted, prone, curled and main060 displaced tumble cells retain their source-relative offsets without per-cell recentering.
character.faceAndExpression: The pale frontal face rotates, compresses or becomes partly covered by the crown blades. Several effort/alert cells expose a red open mouth; compact, prone and special silhouettes preserve the donor visibility or occlusion rather than repeating one face.
character.locomotion: Motion is driven by tiny root contacts and whole-body squash, hop, lean, stretch, curl, prone collapse and tumble. The two crown blades lag, lift, trail, fold over the face or spread along the ground according to each source cell.
character.morphology: Small upright seed/pod creature with one compact oval body, two broad flexible crown blades attached at the top, a readable frontal face and tiny root-like ground contacts; it has no torso limbs, wings or tail.
character.restraint: Main cells 026-042 are the donor-specific restrained contract, including aliases. A separate brown/gold horizontal binding wraps the body through neutral, compressed, tall, open-mouth and prone states; it is a prop, never anatomy.
character.specialStates: Main043 is orange-red, main044 is the tall black silhouette, main045 is the compact black silhouette with pale feature, main058 is stone-gray, and main061 is the white evolution silhouette. These state colors are deterministic when the alpha relation permits.
